note: SHA256 computed on the cloud host over the four uploaded files. SPAI/AIDE distribute weights via Google Drive, which this instance cannot reach, so there is no published official hash to compare against. These are the registered cloud-side identities; if the uploader's local hashes differ, the uploaded file is not the same one. Do not report these as 'official hash verified'.

spai.torch_load_note: contains yacs.config.CfgNode; torch.load(weights_only=True) fails. Trusted official upload, load with weights_only=False and mmap=True.
